Trimmed with leather, it’s handcrafted in Portugal from Italian suede that’s brushed for a uniquely fluffy texture. This pair comes with a second set of tonal laces.

This model is set on a sleek, flat outsole with a unique knit-inspired finish that echoes design elements from our ready-to-wear collections.
items.title: Slow Runner

The Daze Runner offers a pared-back reinterpretation of the classic low-profile sneaker. They’re handcrafted in Portugal from soft suede, leather and intricately woven textile to interlocking panels, and set on a knit-inspired rubber outsole.

items.description:
The Zane Sneaker brings a refined touch to your everyday rotation. Handmade in Portugal from plush suede, featuring a tonal flat lace-up closure and finished with gold foil branding. Grounded on a custom-moulded rubber sole, it’s designed for comfort that doesn’t compromise on style.

Each pair comes with two sets of laces, including a dark grey and a pink option.

items.description:
Cut from organic cotton, the oversized Distort T-shirt is crafted using an old-dye technique to achieve a vintage look. Blurred mirrored branding details the front.

This item has undergone a specialized dyeing process to give it a vintage look. As a result, all pieces are unique and include small variations in dimension and color. The color will continue to fade with wear, enhancing the distressed finish. We recommend washing this garment with similar colors. Do not spot clean as this will lead to localized fading. We advise against wearing light garments underneath as color transfer may occur.

This item has undergone a specialized printing process. As a result, each print is unique and includes small variations in intensity.
